GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide without cover throughout. Laid out from the 500m and over the concluding stages proved difficult to ride.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok wider out pushing on Soon After crossed & led marginally (1400m), travelled ok To The Turn , Straightened Up kicking 2 Lengths Clear & going for home! Feeling pinch 150, just held on # led/kicked/lasted

Jumped well Ridden Along looking to find the front & did So balancing up marginally Clear fence (1400m), little peace To The Turn , Straightened Up Under Pressure & soon spent, faded out of it (vet checked, all Clear ) # pressured in lead
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr could offer no explanation for disappointing performance other than gelding may not have backed up from its last start at the Gold Coast on the 5/9/26. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out pushing on wanted the front & got it ran 3 Lengths Clear (1400m), margin a length 800, joined near 600 headed into the Straight however far from done with! Rallied hard only to be nailed last stride # led for 1799m/stiff
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. When quest re tactics, Rdr explained when caught wide early, was of view had to press on to avoid covering extra ground, which resulted in mount taking the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, tightened 1200m & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved a half length in Straight # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1200m tightened for room and steadied. Near the 300m, momentarily held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok drifted back 6 Lengths off the lead between rivals Two Wide (1000m), urged Turn & into the Straight plenty of room Wide out to run on Under Whip , couldn't (Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # did nothing

(ex Marcus Wilson) Jumped ok Caught Wide had cover though 3 Lengths (1000m), got in Two Wide Soon After a length Further back, Clear for home trying to run on labouring though, no run on at all # no run on/fitter

Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 0.75 Lengths settling down, went clear and crossed at 1050m, Held Together in front & led a half length jointly turning, Headed after Straightening Up , battled to the 200m then weakened to the line. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # weakened last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to initial Lead on fence, Headed at 1050m then held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, Held Up home turn then got the split early in Straight and ran on to the line. [Stewards: Raced greenly passing the 100m.] # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced greenly passing the 100m. Eased from heels over the concluding stages.
